headlines.title: Duke Energy takes down hundreds of fake websites, social media accounts and ads to help protect customers
headlines.summary: Duke Energy has removed hundreds of fake websites, social media accounts and online ads since November 2025 as part of an expanded effort to protect customers from increasingly sophisticated utility scams.

headlines.title: Duke Energy shares simple energy- and money-saving tips as cold front moves into North Carolina
headlines.summary: Some of the chilliest air of the season is moving into North Carolina, bringing below-average temperatures and the potential for the season's first widespread frost and freeze this weekend. The National Weather Service says overnight temperatures will fall into the low to mid 30s in many areas as colder air settles across the state, with the cold air lingering through the middle of next week.

headlines.title: ETFs Are Net Sellers of Duke Energy (DUK) on Nov. 10
headlines.summary: ETFs sold a net $43.7 million of Duke Energy stock on Tuesday.

headlines.title: What Could Duke Energy (DUK) Gain From Four New Florida Solar Sites?
headlines.summary: Duke Energy (NYSE:DUK) said Duke Energy Florida will build four new solar sites with 300 MW of capacity in its service area. The utility projects the new solar build will contribute to about US$1b in customer savings over the life of the projects. Duke Energy Florida plans to pair the solar rollout with utility scale battery storage aimed at improving system reliability.

headlines.title: Duke Energy (DUK) Secures Merger Credit Consent On A Narrative That Still Sees Value
headlines.summary: Duke Energy (DUK) just amended its multi borrower credit agreement, securing lender consent for an internal merger between Duke Energy Progress and Duke Energy Carolinas while keeping a US$10b revolving facility in place. Set against this financing update, Duke Energy’s share price has risen 9.4% over the past month and 9.6% year to date, while its 1 year total shareholder return of 7.6% contrasts with a very strong 3 year total shareholder return of 60.9%.

description: Duke Energy Corporation, through its subsidiaries, operates as an energy company in the United States. The company operates through two segments: Electric Utilities and Infrastructure (EU&I); and Gas Utilities and Infrastructure (GU&I). The EU&I segment generates, transmits, distributes, and sells electricity to customers in the Southeast and Midwest regions. It generates electricity through coal, hydroelectric, natural gas, oil, renewables, and nuclear fuel. This segment also engages in the wholesale of electricity to municipalities, electric cooperative utilities, and other load-serving entities. The GU&I segment distributes natural gas to customers in the residential, commercial, industrial, and power generation natural gas sectors; and invests in pipeline transmission projects, renewable natural gas projects, and natural gas storage facilities. The company was formerly known as Duke Energy Holding Corp. and changed its name to Duke Energy Corporation in April 2006. Duke Energy Corporation was founded in 1904 and is headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina.
